text:
Jake: Hey team — can someone take a quick look at PR #4123? It's a small Terraform + k8s change for the OrchidHealth private deploy VPC routing. Customer sees intermittent pod-to-service failures when reserved IPs are used. Need a fast review/merge if possible.

Nina: Looking now, drop the PR link pls.

Jake: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 — changes the vpc peering route and adds an annotation to the service account used by the sidecar. Tests + migration steps in the description.

CI-bot: CI started for branch fix/orchid-vpc-route — unit tests passed, e2e queued. (build 9853)

Tara: e2e failing on ingress smoke: 502s during canary stage. Logs show conntrack drops. @Samir can you take a look at the iptables ordering?

Samir: Pulling the branch. If it's only route table + nat rule order we can hotfix with a small iptables reorder in the init container. Will run local repro.

Nina: Heads up — PR touches tf modules in infra/modules/network. We need a state migration note / step for dedicated customers. Please add a short rollback/migration snippet to the PR description before merge.

Jake: Added migration steps — copy pasted here for quick review:

```
# migration: move route to new resource
terraform state mv module.orchid.aws_route.old_route module.orchid.aws_route.new_route
terraform apply -target=module.orchid.aws_route
```

Also added a rollback snippet in case the peering needs revert.

CI-bot: e2e (smoke) passed for build 9853; integration tests still running.

Samir: Local smoke looks good. The iptables reorder fixed the 502s in my repro. I'll approve once CI integration completes. Can we plan a 2:15pm PST merge and canary? Customer is in us-west and prefers low-traffic window.

Tara: Approved from infra side pending final CI green. @Maya (CS) can you notify OrchidHealth of a 10-15min maintenance window at ~2:15pm PST?

Maya (CS): Yep, I'll message the customer and have support on standby.

CI-bot: All tests passed — build 9853 marked green.

Samir: Approved.

Jake: Merging now and starting canary deploy to orchid-prod-vpc.

Deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: orchid-prod-vpc -> 5% traffic, image: platform@sha256:... , rollout id: r-20260310-07. Monitoring for errors.

Oncall-Bot: Notifying oncall: will alert if p95 latency > 200ms or error-rate > 1% for 10m.

Jake: Thanks all — I'll keep the thread updated. :rocket:
